A body of mass m has a weight W in a location where the gravitational field strength is g.
Which statement about these quantities is correct?
A
m and W are both forces.
B
m and W are both vector quantities.
W= g.
C
m and W are related by the equation m
D
m and W have the same unit.

options.label: A
options.text: m and W are both forces.

options.label: B
options.text: m and W are both vector quantities.

options.label: C
options.text: m and W are related by the equation m

options.label: D
options.text: m and W have the same unit.
